open.description: Which unknowns this exchange is to settle. At least one, or there is nothing to ask.

id.description: Session id, handle or name, where one is known. Absent is normal for a person.

askedOf.description: Who is being asked. The two participant kinds are symmetric — the same skill serves human-to-agent and agent-to-agent — but the answer's weight differs, so the kind is recorded rather than inferred.

candidates.description: Harnesses the agent has already narrowed to from context — a repository whose root already holds a declaration, `<name>.json`, is not a blank slate. Narrowing first is what keeps this to one question.

knownRepositories.description: Repositories already evident from the checkout, each with the part it is known to play. Offered so the participant confirms or corrects rather than recites.

url.description: Clone URL or path. Not required to be reachable — a Bootstrapping Agent may have been told about a repository it cannot yet fetch.

role.description: Which part this repository plays. A flat list loses the distinction, and the distinction is the whole reason for determining them: it is where the new declaration lands.

context.description: What the agent read to get this far, in one or two sentences. Lets the participant answer without re-establishing the situation.

title: DiscussionInputSchema
